_note: 學習路徑內容建置第5批 #3／6：不定代名詞（eng.t_mid.pron.indefinite，會考級／中階）。some-（someone/something）用肯定句與禮貌提議；any-（anyone/anything）用問句與否定句；no-（no one/nobody/nothing）本身已否定，動詞保持肯定；-one/-body/-thing 皆配單數動詞。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核（每選項代入 stem 驗唯一正解、play-through 朗讀）。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix idp_）。

units.can_do: 我能在肯定句用 some- 字（someone、something）、在問句和否定句用 any- 字（anyone、anything）、用 no- 字（nobody、nothing，動詞保持肯定）表達「沒有人／沒有東西」，並讓這些字配單數動詞（Everyone is here）。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: The 'some-' words (someone, somebody, something) are normally used in affirmative sentences, and in offers and requests: Someone is at the door. Would you like something to drink?
claims.verification_ref: some- 用肯定句與提議；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The 'any-' words (anyone, anybody, anything) are normally used in questions and in negative sentences: Is anyone there? I don't have anything to do.
claims.verification_ref: any- 用問句與否定句；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The 'no-' words (no one, nobody, nothing) already carry a negative meaning, so the verb stays positive: Nobody came. There is nothing to eat. (not 'Nobody didn't come')
claims.verification_ref: no- 本身已否定、動詞保持肯定；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Indefinite pronouns ending in -one, -body or -thing take a singular verb: Everyone is happy. Something smells good. Nobody knows.
claims.verification_ref: 不定代名詞配單數動詞；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: Indefinite pronouns are some/any/no/every + one/body/thing. someone and somebody both mean a person, and something means a thing (not a person). Use some- words in affirmative sentences.
teach.zh_hint: 不定代名詞＝some／any／no／every ＋ one／body／thing。someone＝somebody（某人）、something（某物）。肯定句用 some- 字。

teach.body: Someone is knocking at the door. I heard something.
teach.zh_hint: 有人在敲門。我聽到某個聲音。肯定句用 some-。

teach.body: Use any- words (anyone, anything) in questions and negatives. no- words (nobody, nothing) already mean 'not any', so the verb stays affirmative and you do not add not again.
teach.zh_hint: 問句和否定句用 any- 字（anyone、anything）。no- 字（nobody、nothing）本身就帶「沒有」的意思，所以動詞保持肯定，不再加 not。

teach.body: Is anyone home? I didn't see anything. Nobody answered.
teach.zh_hint: 有人在家嗎？我什麼都沒看到。沒有人回答。問句／否定用 any-；no- 已含否定。

teach.body: These words that end in -one/-body/-thing are all treated as singular, so use a singular verb (is, has, likes).
teach.zh_hint: 這些以 -one／-body／-thing 結尾的字都當單數看，動詞用單數（is、has、likes）。

teach.body: Everyone is here and everything is ready.
teach.zh_hint: 每個人都到了，每件事都準備好了。-one／-thing 配單數動詞 is。

practice.stem: 填入正確的詞：Listen! ____ is singing in the next room.（聽！有人在隔壁房間唱歌。肯定句）

distractor_rationales.Anyone: any- 字用在問句或否定句；這是肯定句，要用 Someone。
distractor_rationales.No one: No one 是「沒有人」，和「正在唱歌」矛盾。
distractor_rationales.Anything: Anything 指東西不是人；而且要用肯定句的 Someone。

practice.feedback: 肯定句用 some- 字：Someone is singing in the next room。

practice.stem: 填入正確的詞：I'm bored. I don't have ____ to do.（我好無聊。我沒有事情可以做。否定句）

distractor_rationales.something: some- 字一般不用在否定句；否定句要用 anything。
distractor_rationales.nothing: don't 已經是否定，再用 nothing 會變雙重否定（don't have nothing）不標準。
distractor_rationales.everything: everything 是「每件事」，意思不對。

practice.feedback: 否定句（don't have）用 any- 字：I don't have anything to do。

practice.stem: 填入正確的詞：I knocked, but ____ answered the door.（我敲了門，但沒有人來應門。）

distractor_rationales.anybody: 在這個句子要表達『沒有人來應門』，不能用 anybody（anybody answered 不通）；要用含否定意的 nobody。
distractor_rationales.somebody: somebody answered 表示「有人應門」，和 but（卻沒人）矛盾。
distractor_rationales.everybody: everybody 是「每個人」，意思不對。

practice.feedback: nobody 本身＝沒有人，動詞保持肯定：but nobody answered the door。

practice.stem: 填入正確的動詞：Everyone in my class ____ the new teacher.（我班上每個人都喜歡新老師。）

distractor_rationales.like: Everyone 當單數看，動詞要用單數 likes。
distractor_rationales.are liking: Everyone 是單數不用 are，而且 like 是狀態動詞不用進行式。
distractor_rationales.don't like: don't 是複數形且意思變否定；Everyone 要用單數肯定 likes。

practice.feedback: Everyone 配單數動詞：Everyone in my class likes the new teacher。

practice.stem: 填入正確的詞：The fridge is empty. There is ____ to eat.（冰箱空了。沒有東西可以吃。）

distractor_rationales.anything: There is anything 不通；any- 要用在問句或否定句。這裡動詞 is 是肯定，要用含否定意的 nothing。
distractor_rationales.something: something 表示「有東西」，和「冰箱空了」矛盾。
distractor_rationales.everything: everything 表示「每樣東西」，和「冰箱空了」矛盾。

practice.feedback: 動詞是肯定的 is，用含否定意的 nothing：There is nothing to eat。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: Someone left a bag here, but nobody knows whose it is.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：Someone 和 nobody 有沒有用對，knows 有沒有加 -s（nobody 配單數），逗號和句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。問句句尾可上揚，直述句句尾下收。

lines.text: Is there anything I can do to help?
lines.intonation: 問句、句尾略上揚、anything 稍強調

lines.text: Everybody is welcome to join us.
lines.intonation: 平穩、Everybody 稍強調、句尾下收
